svg.aria-label: Standing Dumbbell Press, Rack: Stand tall with both dumbbells at shoulder height and your ribs down.
svg.title: Standing Dumbbell Press, Rack: Stand tall with both dumbbells at shoulder height and your ribs down.

svg.aria-label: Standing Dumbbell Press, Press: Press both dumbbells overhead without leaning back.
svg.title: Standing Dumbbell Press, Press: Press both dumbbells overhead without leaning back.

svg.aria-label: Standing Dumbbell Press, Overhead: Finish with long arms and the weights above your shoulders.
svg.title: Standing Dumbbell Press, Overhead: Finish with long arms and the weights above your shoulders.

svg.aria-label: Standing Dumbbell Press, Lower: Lower both dumbbells under control to shoulder height.
svg.title: Standing Dumbbell Press, Lower: Lower both dumbbells under control to shoulder height.
